stem: They gave him the pretty gift.
The little sister sang very nicely.

We will show him the map.

He gave them a small prize.
They will hand her warm coat.
We will buy him blue truck.
The tired mother will help us.
The brave father fixed it fast.

The kind father clapped very gently.
The kind aunt fixed my kite.
The young girl sang very nicely.
The old grandpa told us stories.
The wet mud hit my shoe.
